address: 8 Mirzə İbrahimov, Nasimi, AZ1005 Baku, Azerbaijan
name: The Nest Hotel Baku
description:
Sign in to unlock the members-only price for your selected dates at The Nest Hotel Baku


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: The Nest Hotel Baku in Baku offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes a work desk, minibar, and free WiFi.

Convenient Facilities: Guests benefit from private check-in and check-out, a 24-hour front desk, daily housekeeping, and a tour desk. Additional services include bike hire, room service, and luggage storage.

Dining Options: A variety of breakfast options are available, including continental, buffet, vegan, and halal. Breakfast includes local specialities, fresh pastries, pancakes, cheese, and juice.

Prime Location: Located 2 km from Baku Railway Station and less than 1 km from Maiden Tower, the hotel is near attractions such as the Azerbaijan Carpet Museum and Palace of The Shirvanshahs. Heydar Aliyev International Airport is 24 km away.Solo travellers particularly like the location — they rated it 9.2 for a one-person stay.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
fine_print: Guests are required to show a photo identification and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.Please inform The Nest Hotel Baku in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation.This property will not accommodate hen, stag or similar parties.Guests under the age of 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.

policies.content: Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type. Please check what conditions may apply to each option when making your selection.

policies.title: Children and beds
policies.content: Child policies Children of any age are welcome. To see correct prices and occupancy information, please add the number of children in your group and their ages to your search. Cot and extra bed policies 0 - 6 years Cot always available The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property.

policies.content: When booking more than 3 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply.

pros.description: Location: Short walk to Nizami Street, Fountain Square, and the Old City.
Staff: Friendly team provides warm service and helpful local advice.

cons.description: Room Cleanliness: Generally tidy, though some guests report floor stains, dust, and ants.
Room Soundproofing: Disturbance from street traffic, loud music, and internal ventilation noise.
Breakfast: Varied sweet and savory options, but served in a small, crowded room.
